title: US-Australia agreement begins superconducting quantum RF sensor evaluations
summary: A public engineering report describes a three-year SwRI-Adelaide University agreement and first-phase evaluations of superconducting quantum RF sensors for signals-intelligence applications.

title: Room-temperature diamond NV register verifies multiple-quantum coherences
summary: A public research report describes a parallel multi-qubit entangling gate on a room-temperature nitrogen-vacancy center in diamond, with entangled states verified by measuring multiple-quantum coherences.

title: Cornell explores reconfigurable programmable photonic chips for quantum light
summary: Cornell reports a Moore Foundation-supported project to explore photonic chips that can be reconfigured after fabrication to perform different operations with quantum light.

title: Stopped-light-enhanced gravitational force sensing
summary: A Nature Nanotechnology article reports gravitational-force sensing enhanced by stopped light.

title: Lossy recurrent state for old agent history may fail exact recall
summary: A public alphaXiv post states that recurrent state for old history is lossy and proposes testing exact recall of an early token after a long tail against plain compaction.
